title: Skip the Line Vatican, Sistine Chapel & St. Peter's Tour | Small Group & Private
description: The Vatican Museums, home to Raphael’s Rooms and the world-famous Sistine Chapel, is one of Italy’s most popular attractions. On this intimate guided tour, get skip-the-line access to incredible galleries, ancient sculptures, and Renaissance masterworks— topped off with an exclusive visit to St. Peter’s Basilica, where you beat the crowds with your own private entranceway. All entrance fees included for a seamless experience.

reviews.usertext:
Our tour guide was great, she was able to provide us with lots of information about the vatican city and the sistine chaple before entering the chapel. The only downside of this tour was the number of people in the vatican city and the chaple during the tour. The tour company was very smart to split the group up into several smaller groups to help provide a better experience and keep people together.
We were not able to go into Saint Peter's Church coming out of the sistine chapel because the passageway was closed. However, the church is free to enter and can be accessed from another entry way you just needed to wait in line.
The weather this time of year was cool and was a great time to go because it was warm inside to vatican museum and chapel

I would like to express our thanks and pleasure with Uta and LivTours for our early access small group tour of the vatican. She did a great job of sharing her knowledge about the Vatican, its museums and St Peters. She was informative, attentive and a joy to spend the morning with. I would give her a 10 out of 10 and would not hesitate to book with LivTours again. We felt the tour was well worth the money and getting up early to avoid the crowds. Truly a wonderful experience!

The tour of the Museum(s), the Sistine Chapel and St. Peter's was excellent. Davide clearly knows the subject matter and shares information with passion and humour. It was like strolling among priceless objets d'art accompanied by a knowledgeable friend; relaxed and informal. When you see the lines waiting to get into the Vatican, you realize just how valuable skipping the line can be.

We have a semi private tour with Deborah. The group was a total of six people. The information and excitement that Deborah brought to the tour was amazing. The stories she told, the information she shared and just the way she brought every painting to life was worth every penny.

LivTours was very easy to deal with, and communicated as needed in a very efficient way.

It is insanity inside the museum and we were so grateful to have a guide help us get through the crowds to see the masterpieces.

We took the “Vatican & Sistine Chapel Small Group Tour” with LivTours as the early entrance was not being offered on the day we were scheduled. Our tour guide was Dario and we had two other couples from the U.S. on this tour. Let me start with how easy it was to book the tour as LivTours has an easy to use website. Their mobile app has all the information you’ll need for the city you are touring including virtual reality experiences and your voucher and meeting location information. Dario was definitely a pro at touring the Vatican, he provided so many fascinating details about the amazing Vatican collection and Sistine Capel. He knew the significant pieces and did a great job providing the historical relevance. He knew where to stand and the best places for photos. Dario made sure to engage with each person in the group and someone connected background, cities your were visiting, or where you were from to something on the tour. He remembered every person’s name and was conscious of the pace given the older couple in the group. The highlight was the Sistine Chapel and I felt knowledgeable examining this amazing room based on the information Dario shared before the tour. St Peter’s Basilica is not to be missed as well, Although you could tour St Peter’s for free, I believe is was worth it to tour with an experienced guide like Dario, absolutely incredible.

We highly recommend LivTours.
-Bill & Lenore Freitas

It has been a life-long dream of mine to see the Vatican. I was warned that it would be crowded, but it was CROWDED. At times it could be hard to hear our guide, Santi, even though our group was only six people. However, what information I could hear from him I thought was very helpful and interesting! He was patient and informative, and he made sure to show us some of his favorite pieces of art within the museums. This tour takes you to the Vatican museums (through them quickly, but not comprehensively), then to the Sistine Chapel, which surpassed my expectations. It does not take you through St. Peter's Basilica, but it does end right at the entrance of that and entry is free. Be sure to wear clothes that cover your knees and shoulders, otherwise they will deny you admission. Overall, chaotic, but amazing. Santi was adorable and I would highly recommend. He seemed genuinely interested in engaging with us and answering any questions we may have (not only about the tour, but about Italy in general).

The tour was excellent and informative. The Vatican museum is huge and can be overwhelming so we are thankful to have had our tour guide. I also definitely recommend the smaller group as again a larger group can be overwhelming and the guide has more time to answer your questions.

This was an amazing tour thanks to our most incredible tour guide, Paola! The way she presented the information, weaving in little known interesting facts, made us feel a part of history and helped us to retain the information. She was incredibly knowledgeable, passionate about her role (because this was not a "job" to her, it was a privilege and pleasure for her to impart her knowledge with us!) and an overall caring, compassionate person. We had another couple from another country with us and she did her best to ensure they could understand (after her first attempt to try and find another suitable tour guide from their country). Then, she performed miracles for my husband who has low back issues to help him along the way with seats, access to lifts and then provided the option to take a taxi to St. Peter's since the private access was closed due to COVID. She then went on into St. Peter's with us, even though the tour was to end, and provided such amazing information with little known facts that made the tour even more interesting! From now on, I will look for LivItaly Tours when again visiting. Worth every penny and then some! We also learned that Paola does the Colosseum Underground tour so would HIGHLY recommend to ask for her when booking either of these tours!

Our tour guide Sara Napolitano was absolutely amazing. She made the experience so engaging and clearly knows a ton of information and was able to answer all of our questions. The tour itself was fantastic but Sara truly made it above and beyond with her kind spirit and wonderful storytelling. We highly recommend this tour and if you are lucky enough to have Sara as your guide you will not be disappointed.

Our tour with Ella was superb! She was able to get us in quickly and accommodate elderly mom with a bad knee and kept a close eye on our group of 7 ensuring we didn’t separate. Her supporting commentary also came with pictures on her tablet that helped explain the structures and before/after photos of restoration. She had so much knowledge of the art and was able to give us a very detailed description of what we were going to see in the Sistine Chapel. We moved quickly from room to room but she was able to reference where we were and where we had come from to orient us. We highly recommend Ella as your guide!!

Wonderful guide (Roberta). Would HIGHLY recommend the small group. It was worth the money to pay for the small group (no more than 6 people). Lot of background information about the Vatican. Roberta highlighted the important details of the artwork, as she walked us through the museum and into the basilica.

Elizabeth was very knowledgeable and with the overwhelming number of things to see, she pointed out and gave the story behind the most important sculptures, art and tapestries. I highly recommend this tour. Having only 6 people allowed us to not waste time in lines and to ask questions and have a very personalized tour. I highly recommend this tour!

Our tour guide Lucia for The Vatican and Sistine Chapel was not only very nice and approachable, but also extremely knowledgable of the vast history of The Vatican, Sistine Chapel and all other relating to it. For such short tour (~3HRS), Lucia tried her best to ensure that she goes over the most important details and history with keeping timelines in mind. Lucia gladly answered any questions we asked and explains it in detail. We would highly recommend Lucia with LivTours for your Vatican and Sistine Chapel tour needs.

**NOTE: 3-4HRS is definitely not enough time and we would recommend to get a full day tour (if that is even an option) because, no matter who the tour guide or tour company you choose, 3-4 hours is simply too short to go over, digest and savor all of the rich history of The Vatican and Sistine Chapel.**

We had a great tour guide in Silvia. She was funny and did a good job of telling us stories and pointing our attention to specific highlights. She was also very good at navigating us through the very dense crowds. I can't imagine doing a large group tour under those conditions. I thought it was worth paying extra to have the small group - which ended up being 6 of us. Just know the meeting point is a little chaotic with multiple groups meeting at the same spot, so don't be afraid to ask people who are standing around with badges where you should wait because it's not obvious.

We made it just on time to the cafe to join Linda our guide along with a family of 4, making a total of 6 people. I don’t recommend any larger if possible. We navigated through the various art displays and exhibits of the Vatican and Linda was full of unique information and insight but not corny or too talkative. She took the time to explain various highlights for us. Everyone seemed to know who she was in the area. We toured the Sisteen chapel and then St Peter’s Basilica. My second time my wife second time. But never together. We got in and out and we’re very happy with all we learned and the pace of the trip. Recommend getting early as the later in the day the longer you are going to be there.

Laurie Scasi was an excellent tour guide for our day at the vatican. She made sure we were amongst the first ten people to enter the museum in the morning and offered a personal touch with her commentary throughout the tour. I would highly recommend booking a tour with her!!!!

We do not normally book guided tours, but given the size of the Vatican decided to do so on this occasion, and even to go for the more expensive small group tour with LivTours. What a great decision this turned out to be!
With only five of us on the tour headsets were not needed. Our guide Julia was enthusiastic and had a great personality, passing on an incredible but never overwhelming amount of information in an enjoyable way.

My favorite part was the emotion of seeing the Pieta and the majestic feel of the Sistine Chapel. But the whole tour was awesome - The Vatican Museum with all the art was beautiful. Our tour guide, Julia, was wonderful. She was very enthusiastic about the art we were seeing and gave very thorough, vivid explanations of them. She really made the artists come to life as real people you could imagine knowing in her explanations of their art and place in history. She also did a particularly excellent presentation of the Sistine chapel, explaining each and every panel, prior to entering the chapel, so that when you were inside, you knew what you were looking at. I was there on a Saturday afternoon which was packed, and I also thought Julia did a great job of navigating the huge crowd, keeping our tour together, and getting us up close to see the art in spite of the crowds. Incidentally, someone on our tour had an initial headset that did not work, and Julia did a great job of solving that problem without compromising the tour for anyone else on it. After the tour, I had lunch outside in the piazza at the Vatican, which was relaxing and lovely. If I had any tips for future travelers, it would be to learn as much as you can about Michaelangelos life, as it really brings a completely different understanding to his art. I wouldn’t do this tour without skip the line tickets and a guide to explain everything. I would also plan time to visit gift shops and sit in the piazza. And it is a lot of walking so wear comfortable shoes!

Absolutely the best tour in 35 years of touring. Sabrina is the most knowledgeable, passionate and flexible guide for your Vatican experience. She knows all of the details and the staff of the museum to expertly guide you through the mass of artifacts and crowds. St. Peter’s is her home church, so you get the perspective from a local who is passionate and knowledgeable about the history.
LIV was organized and the directions for ticketing and meeting were clear with no surprises. Our group was 4 people. Hate to write this review for fear she wont be available for ourselves or friends on the next trip but her passion needs to be shared.

The Vatican, Sistine Chapel, and St. Peter’s cathedral are worth a visit - be prepared for crowds but there is nothing anyone can do about that. This was a very good tour and Giovanna was extremely friendly and knowledgeable. It was just very hard to hear her at times. When she turned her head away from the microphone we couldn’t hear her at all. We let her know and she started holding the microphone in front of her mouth and that helped. It was extremely helpful to have a guide who could lead us to exceptional pieces and talk about them.

To be able to absorb and digest the amount of art and religion in the Vatican, one needs an awesome, knowledgeable and talented tour guide. Now when we think of the greats - Michelangelo, Raphael and Bernini - we will also think of our tour guide Massimo. Seemingly knows more people there than the Pope! He is also in charge of keeping all the other tour guides in line. You’ll see :)

Put on your running shoes and be prepared to absorb an incredible amount of interesting, cool and retainable facts. Viewing all the known must sees was of course amazing. But the real treasures of this tour are all the OTHER super cool things that you will see and learn about, that just about every other group with ear pieces and following their tour guide flags pass by unknowingly.

The 6 people group size is really a privilege. We could not imagine navigating the throngs of people with more. Perfect.

Grazie for an unbelievable and unforgettable day!

Jon and Tania (from Canada)

A very interesting and engaging tour by Annalisa, she is so nice, passionate and very knowledgeable. We enjoyed the tour so much and we didn't want it to end! So worth booking, we asked her so many questions and kept wanting to hear more and more amazing stories and details about all the pieces of art we saw. The Vatican museums are so huge and I think it is impossible to cover them in even 2 days, we wish we could do that with Annalisa!!
She recommended a restaurant when we asked her about a recommendation for a restaurant, and we went there after the tour finished and the food was just AMAZING! Thank you Annalisa!

We loved our tour of the Vatican Museum, Sistine Chapel and St Peter's Basilica. It was a hot day and being able to skip the line was well worth the money. Our tour guide, as an art historian, was an excellent source of knowledge and we learned amazing things about the vast collection of art, tapestries, sculptures and buildings. The tour was about three hours long and we loved our guide. We would highly recommend this tour.

Roberta was an excellent tour guide. I visited the Vatican on my own many years ago, but this time I was with my teenage son and his friend (two 14-year olds) both of whom have only minimal historical knowledge of Rome and Italy. It was August and incredibly hot and crowded in the Vatican. Roberta was incredibly knowledgeable and understanding that the boys could not absorb and retain too much information. She answered all of my own questions to a satisfying level of detail and tried to keep it interesting for the boys. The Vatican is absolutely overwhelming, so it was useful to have Roberta highlight the most relevant and important artists and historical periods. Despite the summer heat and crowds, Robert was fully engaged, pleasant and very friendly. I would absolutely recommend doing this tour with Roberta. She made what could have been a torturous visit (because of the heat, crowds and shher scale of the Vatican) both pleasurable and memorable!

Our guide Elaine was both knowledgeable and entertaining. She tailored the tour to meet the needs of our small group, made up of two couples and one family of three. St Peter's Baslica and the Vatican Museum were a highlight of our trip and would recommend to anyone. The explanation of the Sistine Chapel really helped us to get our heads around what we were looking at. The 4 hour tour was long but flew by and there were well timed breaks to take the weight off.

We had a fabulous time on this tour! Our guide, Luca, was so knowlegable and patient. He truly loves his job and it shows by the care and detail he shares with visitors. We were never rushed and we were surprised midway through with a breakfast snack of coffee, meats and pastries.

We did have to wait in line, but the lines moved quickly and Luca has so much information to share about art. I truly loved seeing the Sistine Chapel in such a small group. I had seen pictures of people shoulder to shoulder and that would've been miserable. Luca provided in-depth explanations about the ceiling so when we went in, we knew what we were seeing and the stories behind this great work of art.

I was confused about the attire however. It explicitly states dresses and skirts below the knee, but I saw several women with dresses above the knee who had no problem getting in. Maybe revise the language to reflect that.

The Vatican, Sistine and St. Peter's are not to be missed, yet they can be an overwhelming experience due to the sheer size and the crowds. The skip the line tour with an expert guide made for a much more relaxing and informed experience. Nadiya led us seamlessly through all of the check points and showed us some amazing highlights. Her calming demeanor and expertise were key to taking in the the amazing collection of art, architecture and history. The Vatican museums are impressive. Although the concentration of art and crowds makes the experience less accessible, it is an experience in culture. A highlight was witnessing my kids take in Michelangelo's artwork in the Sistine Chapel as I had first done years ago. Be patient and wait for a seat. It takes a few minutes of relaxing to really immerse yourself in the storytelling. St. Peter's is also magnificent and more restful relative to the museum. We ran out of steam and did not climb the dome. I had forgotten why the Vatican experience is so popular. It was worth the effort and I hope to go back.

This was a really well organized tour of the Vatican! My partner and I were with 4 other people. Our guide was very professional and knowledgeable. Maybe one thing that the tour group cannot control is the amount of people that the Vatican lets into its museum at one time. Each room was packed and hot, and it could be difficult to move at times. The experience was memorable however and the Basilica and Chapel were incredible!

My spouse and I have been on a lot of tours of different types around the world, including several in Italy. Our tour today with LivItaly Tours was definitely the best experience we’ve had so far. Our tour guide Mara led our Small Group Private Tour and she was great! She was extremely thorough as we went through the different areas, but kept it interesting and was always open to questions.

One great innovation – Since visitors to the Sistine Chapel are to be very quiet (definitely no verbal explanations of what you’re seeing), beforehand our guide stood showing us photos of all the depictions we would see, pointing out curious details – as we took a break in the Vatican courtyard with it’s greenery and Sfera con Sfera Globe – Can’t explain it. You have to see it. Anyway, as we later walked around the chapel, it helped put everything into context with the flow of paintings around the entire space. And yes, there really is special access. We walked right in. The area was crowded but not overwhelming and we took our time.

We’ve read reviews of people being whisked down the corridors of the museum, but we stopped to look at dozens of paintings, items, and many antiquities from around the world given as gifts from foreign dignitaries. Who knew! I thought it would only be Romanesque art. I didn’t mention that my spouse and I have chronic conditions that can flair up. Today was a flair day. Mara intuitively noticed that and knew who and how to ask for access to lifts where they were available.

Mara had previews and explanations for St. Peter’s as well, but you can talk quietly there – so we got the run down as we went through. So many other things during the three hours. A lot of things you wouldn’t expect. We’d recommend this tour to anyone who wants to get the most out of their visit to the Vatican.

Giovanna was very professional, patient, and informative. She accommodated the needs of the small group (6 people), which included someone who needed more rest and more time to move between areas, while ensuring we all were able to experience what we expected. She had exclusive access, knew all the alternative routes, and breezed through congested areas. She also advocated for us and was able to move us ahead of the crowds so we had as much time as we needed to enjoy the experience. We had unlimited opportunity to ask questions and Giovanna was equipped with all the answers. I learned so much from her descriptions of the Sistine Chapel and St. Peter's Basilica art! Overall, we were very pleased with the tour and look forward to using LivTours again in the future.

I went on this tour with my 19 year old son - on a super hot summer’s day. The tour was a group of 6 which was really nice as trying to move through the crowds with a big group would have been a lot trickier. Our tour guide Manuela was lovely and knowledgeable. We were taken into a couple of places exclusive to smaller groups which also provided us a breath of quiet. We both loved the tour and all the info. The crowds at the Vatican are not for anyone COvID cautious.

The place was packed but Nadiya was able to navigate us through a somewhat chaotic entrance and museum scene to show us some of the most important architectural and artistic highlights of these beautiful spaces. I thoroughly enjoyed the time spent with this small group tour. I enjoyed reading Michaelangelo, God's Architect by William Wallace at the same time of the tour. It was fascinating to see the feat of construction that St. Peters Basilica became, all while the info from the book was fresh in my mind.

Amazing
Our guide was Beth, she is incredibly and her love for her city Rome is remarkable. Her acknowledge about history, art, Michelle Angelo etc was impressive.
We started on time at 8 am with a group total of 6 and Beth. In to the Vatican on time with a lot of information about Sistine Chapel and Michelle Angelo’s work, life and history. Then to the Sistine Chapel to admire in silence for 20 min ( no pictures allowed). Then she took as to a “ special path” to go to Sn Peter’s Basilica ( thanks God we didn’t have to do the line under the sunny and hot Roman summer), she explained the most important spots of the Basilica. The tour last 3 hrs (8-11). Then we spend 4:30 hrs more on our own ( there is so much to see and learn), went to the Gold Museum (€5 and no pictures allowed). Then we checked the Pope’s Tombs ( downstairs, and no pictures allowed). Overall the day was incredible and our guide Beth gave us tips to spend a good time. For sure next time in Rome we will do a guided tour to the Coliseum and Roman Forum with this company. We appreciate so much your professional service Livetour. Chao !!

Our tour with Massimo was exceptional. From the moment he spoke I knew he had a passion for the art he brings alive on this tour. He was very welcoming and also humorous Theses three attributes, passion, humor and the ability to make us feel so welcome are key to a great tour.
Massimo also prefaced the tour with a virtual presentation that was extremely helpful to understand the way the paintings in the Sistine Chapel were designed to tell a story. He also personalized the tour with some information about his favorite pieces of art. He was a powerful navigator through the crowds and seemed to know all the guards so as to make our tour more expedient than others. He knows the ins and outs of every passageway and was even able to lead us at the end of the tour to the changing of the Swiss Guard. Wonderful time to remember with Massimo !

Private tour with Luciana (Lucy) was definitely worth the money. Her know of history and art made the experience so much more worthwhile than if we had done the tour ourselves. Lucy was passionate about Vatican City, had a great manner, answered all our questions, and deftly guided us through the highlights of the museums despite the big crowds. A great tour!

The tour guide was very patient and could answer all our questions. She was very helpful with anything we needed. She brought all the paintings to life and gave new meaning to them. I highly recommend this tour seeing as it is private and much better than doing it in a big group where you wait much longer for others. We skipped many lines and had quick access to exits. If you do a tour on your own without a guide - what you will see will have no meaning to you and won’t make sense. Robert was excellent and is the most friendly person we have met in Italy!!!

My family of 5 had a most excellent tour with Marta! We actually ended up enjoying a private tour with just our family. And with three teenagers (19, 17, 15), Marta was so good at drawing them into the conversation, asking them questions and sharing their thoughts on all the art/history that they were viewing. Because our group was so small and family, we were very nimble and could maneuver around the larger groups. It was excellent. Highly recommend this tour and ask for Marta!!!

A group of 6, great guide (Beth) and a beautiful sunny day. A bit confused at the start locating the tour company but once sorted we had a great morning.
Guide negotiated the crowds well and was very informative and able to bring the information alive.

WOW. What a tour. Our small group ended up being just my wife and I with Sergio as our tour guide.

OMG. Sergio has so much knowledge of everything in this vast museum and roman history. It was so informative and fascinating.

Let me say right here and now that if you take this tour you must ask for Sergio. You will not be disappointed with his knowledge and service and passion of the arts.

The day we did this tour was so hot and I was struggling with the heat a bit. Sergio noticed this and took time out of the tour to personally go and get a couple of bottles of water for my wife and I to help with the heat. What a kind and caring gesture.

As we went through the 3 hour tour, Sergio would tailor the information he was sharing based on our response to it and he would talk less about things that did not interest us and more about the things that did. It was not just talking through a repetitive routine, but rather a custom tailored experience.

He described everything we would see in the Sistine Chapel before we went in as there is not supposed to be talking inside. I learned so much about the paintings on the ceiling and on the back wall of the chapel. It was fascinating.

On this day the "shortcut" between the Vatican and St Peter's was closed so Sergio walked with us around to the entrance of St Peter's and brought us inside. He showed us so many fascinating things that you may not notice on your own.

At one point in the tour I had a change to talk to Sergio a bit personally and I could have talked with him for ages. Thanks Sergio for a great afternoon.

Please take this tour. Please ask for Sergio, you will not be disappointed.

I'd been dreaming of seeing the wonderful art in Vatican City for many years. This tour exceeded my expectations. Dario, our guide, was extremely knowledgeable and his passion for the subjects at hand was evident. It was so worth it to go with a small group and skip the lines, which were significant. Go early - you also are ahead of the crowds and have unobstructed views. St. Peter's Basilica was not to miss. Make sure that is included on your tour. Also, it was fascinating to see the modern art in the Vatican's collection. Dali, Van Gogh, Chagall, and much more.

This tour was fantastic! Fancesca was an incredible tour guide. She brought the art to life with her stories and the background information she provided during the tour. She brought us through the Vatican museums, to the Sistine Chapel and to the entrance of St Paul's Cathedral. The line for entry at St Paul's was too long, so she didnt go into the cathedral with us, but provided a lot of background for us before we went in on our own. We only wished we had more time!

My wife and I had a tour with Martina (like the martini!) and two other couples two weeks ago. She was terrific. She gave us a ton of information about the Vatican, including great detail on Sistine Chapel, Rafael and Michelangelo. She was super informative, spoke English very well. The tour is pretty long just to walk it but she had us move through at a nice pace - stopping at key areas to discuss and point out very cool facts, info. It was exactly what we were looking for in a visit to the Vatican. Great job Martina

Our tour was amazing. My partner and I booked this tour but we were upgraded for free to the early morning tour and we ended up being the only ones on it. We got to stand in the sistine chapel by ourselves which was an incredible experience. Finding the meeting spot was easy and getting into the Vatican was very smooth. Our guide was extremely knowledgeable about everything we saw and encouraged our many questions. Overall we had an incredible experience and this was absolutely a standout for us from our trip.

The tour was perfect. We were picked up at our hotel early in the morning to ensure that we would beet the heavy trafic at the Vatican. As one in our party is handicapped our guide Barbara had to ask permission to use an alternative route through the museum. All requests were granted but the one down the stairs between the Sixteenth Chappel and the St Peter’s Basilica so we split the group and all went well in the end😎. Barbara did all she could for us and for that we are grateful and highly recommend her services.

While the Vatican, Sistine Chapel, and St. Peter's was very crowded with many tours and guests, our tour was still memorable and enjoyable. Our tour guide, Luciana, was great. She knew how to get through the crowd so that we could maximize our experience. She took very good care of everyone in our group as well. Case in point, getting one member and her companion an easier route to the Sistine Chapel because of mobility issues. Luciana's explanation of the ceiling of the Sistine Chapel before the tour started was so helpful in understanding the many scenes depicted. My family never felt rushed and all of our questions were answered. We enjoyed our time with Luciana in the Vatican and other areas!

Aptly named 'skip the line' as our guide Raffaela snaked our small group of six past long queues, while giving us an informative and understandable guide to the beautiful ceilings, paintings, statues and antiquities stored in the Vatican Museum. An interlude in a cool corner to discuss the Sistine Chapel before we went it, meant we spent the time in spellbound wonder. The Swiss Guards marched smartly past as we went into St Peter's, and a wedding had just been celebrated inside. Three hours went swiftly by. Well worth the extra expense with a good guide.

This tour was spectacular. Very easy, we walked right in with our guide, Claudia, and she took us through all the major galleries and sights with true expertise. Claudia explained all the important things we needed to know to understand the Sistine Chapel frescoes better so that when we entered the chapel, we could have a full experience, knowing the history and interesting details behind the work. This experience was made a thousand times better because we had such an experienced and knowledgeable guide.

Our tour guide was Sylvia and she was absolutely amazing! I was expecting a smallish tour but it ended up being just the three people in our party with private tour her and she was exceptionally caring and considerate while she led us into the Vatican and showed us all the things and explained the significance of each, the museum and its sites, the Sistine Chapel, and the Basilica. It was just fantastic and made my mother-in-law cry with joy. It was that good.

Our tour guide Massimo created an incredibly smooth Vatican tour experience. We felt like VIP guests! I was thankful he met us on time at the Vatican Cafe across the street from the Vatican entrance. Massimo's tour went above and beyond my expectations. His knowledge of art history and the Vatican's history brought so much life to every minute of the tour for each of our four family members. Massimo engaged us with a high energy! He shared details about the life of Michelangelo and Raphael that made the tour intriguing the entire time. A private tour of the Vatican is worth your vacation money - go for it!!!

Excellent Tour! Davide was the tour guide for a small group of five people. He took his time explaining artifacts, painting, sculptures, etc. and was very knowledgeable in regards to the Vatican, Sistine Chapel and St. Peter's Basilica. Three hours went by fast, but the small group learned a lot. I highly recommend this tour ... Five Stars!

We were so glad that we booked this guided tour.
Without a guide, the visit would have been impossible to navigate and understand the history, artworks etc.
Our guide Lucia was extremely knowledgeable and passionate about the Vatican and its history.
She truly made this an enjoyable experience.

This is a stunning tour. The journey through the Vatican, Sistine chapel and St. Peter’s is an endless stream of incredible art, architecture and history and Luisa wove us through it with insider information that we would otherwise never have learned. She really went above and beyond to bring colour to the history of this amazing place. Definitely worth five stars!

What a wonderful tour! Massimo our guide was exceptional and clearly knows the history well. While he has been leading tours for many years, what we enjoyed most was the passion and humor he brought to the tour. We would recommend this to anyone.

Manuela was our amazing tour guide and was very well connected to get us access to the most exclusive treasures that the Vatican museum had to offer. Later she got us access to St. Peter's Basilica, and we literally skipped a very long line to get in otherwise. Our group was small as promised (us 3 and another party of 3), which was excellent in a very crowded Vatican. Very knowledgeable and passionate about all the artwork there and spent more time with us than what was listed on the tour. I would highly recommend it!

Excellent private tour with LivTours. Our guide Luisa was great. She offered pertinent information throughout the tour and always kept us moving to the important parts of the Museum, Sistine Chapel, and St Peter’s Basilica. It was 95 degrees, yet Luisa found shade for each stop to keep us cool, further adding to a great tour. Highly recommend Liv Tours and Luisa!

The tour was incredible, seeing all the main sights. Massimo is an amazing guide, very personable and helpful. Highlights of the Vatican & Sistine Chapel Tour | Semi-Private on Tuesday, August 23, 2022. Nadiya. WS our guide and she was amazing. I would highly recommend taking this tour. Excellent trip, made special by Silvia who was brilliant. Her knowledge was very impressive and she brought to life the history of the place and made it much more interesting than just a visit. Morning tour with family of teens was just enough to appreciate the Vatican museum, Sistine Chapel and Basilica. Getting in before the crowds is essential and this tour provides you that privilege. The tour and our guide-Michela- were wonderful!!! We were traveling with our young daughter and she made it great. We learned so much interesting information and the guide was charming and engaging. This was a fantastic tour. Everything went smoothly. Meetup and communication was easy. Our guide was extremely knowledgeable and the small group was the best way to see this incredible museum and basilica. Best part of our 3 week tour through Italy.

Azzurra was an excellent guide and made the visit entertaining and interesting! Her passion was evident and she led us on an extraordinary journey through the highlights the Vatican has to offer. Our guide, Annalisa, was very welcoming, enthusiastic and knowledgeable, and made the afternoon fly by. The tour was supposed to last around 3 hours, but ended up being nearer to 4, which was fine with us as we much prefer an unhurried tour with time to really appreciate the buildings and artworks, but something to be wary of if you are on a tight schedule.

We had a great tour - it was only 4 of us, so we had our amazing guide Daniela answer all of our questions. She was also very well organized and we thoroughly enjoyed the tour. The tour starts at the Vatican museum, then going to Sistine chapel and finishing up at St. peter's basilica. I cannot recommend this company enough.

My wife and I we had a wonderful tour! We were just 4 people and had full attention from a most professional guide, Daniela. I highly recomend this tour. We did the 10:00 am tour in an extremely busy day but everything went smooth and we were able to skip all lines.

This trip was absolutely fantastic. My husband and I came to Italy on our honeymoon, and decided to see the Vatican with a small group tour. It was well priced, and luckily for us, no one else booked for that day, so we had a private tour of the Vatican. The guide was informative, friendly, and very helpful, making the experience an amazing one. She knew all the best places and stories, and made for an incredible visit. This tour is a not to be missed opportunity. Thank you so much!

Giulia from Livitaly provided an amazing tour of one of the most breathe taking, fascinating places I've ever been.
Her knowledge and passion of the Vatican, the Sistine Chapel and St Peter's made for an incredible tour. And to add to all of this, it turns out she's an archeologist as well. Fantastic! Thank You Giulia and thank you Livitaly for providing an amazing tour!

The small group tour is THE way to see the Vatican with kids. Our kids are five and seven. We went on Christmas Eve and the crowds were huge, but Rich (our guide) got us right in. He made sure that our kids had a great time, and he spoke directly to them to keep them interested. He gave us great insight into the history and he made sure that we saw all of the important highlights. Thanks so much to Rich for an awesome experience!

We arrived in Rome on the redeye from the U.S. and immediately went to the Vatican after dropping our bags. Despite our lack of sleep, Giulia was so accommodating and knowledgeable about everything that it was easy to remain engaged throughout. Highly recommend spending extra for this tour as it seemed from what I noticed of the other larger groups that the level of insight they offered wasn't nearly enough considering the subject matter. Giulia mentioned she graduated with a degree in archaeologiy (I think) and passed a strenuous exam to be able to perform the tours, which means she knows her s**t. Top notch!

I’d highly recommend this tour, myself and my mum did it and Giulia was amazing! So enthusiastic and informative. Mum is 70 and she was sensitive to sitting us all down where possible (without making it obvious she was thinking of my mum walking for 4 hours). She was clear, fun and the time flew. Mum got overwhelmed in the Sistine chapel and Giulia seemed moved that mum felt the love for the place that she obviously does.
Highly recommend it as the queues were insane and we just walked right past. We had 4 others with us in the tour.
Vivianna was a great tour guide. Very friendly and knowledgeable about all three areas that we visited.

My family and I had a wonderful time on this trip. Deborah was a wonderful guide, both personable and knowledgeable. And skip-the-line access is a godsend. I highly recommend this tour.

Note: This was a family tour, but none of us are teenagers. I'm not sure why just "family" isn't an option.
Well worth the expense, personal small group tour. Quick entry into the museum with a guide that knows their job. Ample information an happy to give further info as needed. Thank you Alessandra!

Go early...the Vatican gets PACKED so do not wait! Pay for the tour—we learned so much and our guide was first class. She took extra care with our teen son who wears cochlear implants—immediately seeing them and grabbing headphones versus ear buds for him. Amazing to see in person!

We booked an early morning tour and it was worth every extra penny! You meet across the street outside the Vatican museum entrance and are randomly paired with a tour guide. We were paired with Luca Romano and he was excellent! You then cross the street to go wait in line for entrance into the museum. While in line Luca gave us a pre-tour on his iPad with pictures and a history background on everything we would see during the tour. It was very helpful because our kids didn't know some of the stories being the Roman history of the Bible. Our tour lasted 3.5 hours but wished it could've been 7. After taking you through several museums, the Sistine Chapel, and St. Peter's Basilica, the tour ends with you having the option to go and tour around yourself. It was 100 degrees on our day so we ended earlier than we wanted to. Luca did a fantastic job as a tour guide. He was extremely nice, funny, and informative. He also gave us great recommendations for restaurants to visit while we were in Rome.

We did both the early morning underground coliseum tour and the Vatican tour with the Sistine chapel. Both tours were fantastic. We had a 13 yr old and two 11 year olds with us who were hot and cranky for most of the time in Rome. Both tour guides were knowledgable and patient with the kids, keeping them engaged, answering any questions they had and moving at the pace we chose. After the tour was over all of the kids later said how much they loved it, and they all agreed the Sistine chapel was their favorite part. The livItaly tour is the best way to see the sights in Rome, I highly recommend it!

Wow. What a fabulous tour. We had Massimo an awesome gentleman who was very knowledgeable. We had two adults and three children (14, 11, 8) in our family group. Massimo made it interesting for all of us. He was happy to stop and take family photos for us. He even got us in to more secluded areas of the Vatican. He knew and was respected by many of the security there. We certainly had the best tour guide for our Vatican tour. So thorough with information and also used his iPad with photos to explain certain parts of the tour. Amazing experience. Would totally recommend this tour especially Massimo.
The tour to the Vatican was just fantastic. Our guide, Davide Falasca was phenomenal. He was extremely knowledgeable, courteous, funny. He definitely made our experience unique

When we approached the meetup place we quickly surmised why reservations for this event are critical. MILES of people in July under the scorching hot Italian sun. While heartwarming to see the mass global draw at this amazing site, its worth the extra dollars to get this set up well in advance.

It was a little tricky finding our guide but we resolved that very quickly. Our guide Vincenzo was outstanding and really made the experience special and memorable for our family. We has only 7 people in our group against others we saw with 30-50. Having that small of a group gave us a great opportunity to explore questions and comment to each other on what we both saw and felt.

Highly recommend this as the BEST way to see this site!
Many thanks to our guide Giulia Pagliari for a terrific tour of the Vatican Museum, Sistine and St Peters. Highly recommend! Grazie Giulia!
Davide Falasca was our guide, he was great! I would recommend this tour to anyone who visits Rome...

Michelangelo's David was our favorite David in Italy until we had the pleasure of touring the Vatican Museum and Sistine Chapel with Davide Falasca of LivItaly Tours. What a fantastic, generous and informative tour guide! One of our travelling companions is partially deaf, and Davide made it his business to speak slowly while looking directly at her to make sure she did not miss any of his comments. Davide is super knowledgeable and made his tour enthralling, and very humorous (be sure to ask him about Sylvester Stallone and Bill Clinton!). Our group was limited to no more than six -- because there were four of us, we were divided into two separate groups, allowing for basically a private tour. We plan on returning next year with a group of friends, and there is no question who we will be requesting for a tour guide. MILLE GRAZIE, DAVIDE!

Deborah was our exceptional tour group for our group's recent (May 2018) Vatican tour. She was absolutely wonderful ! Very knowledgeable, interesting, funny and fit right in with our group. She accommodated our needs and made this tour one of the highlights of our trip to Italy. I would highly recommend Deborah and this tour company !!

Julie W.

Our group was small; 5 people. Our guide, Massimo (excuse my poor spelling) was amazing. Funny, knowledgeable, and so caring and responsive. The Vatican is overwhelming and our guide made it manageable and very enjoyable. He hit all the high points and has interesting stories. This was so much better than the huge cattle tours with headsets. This is a must tour and THE group to use for any tours in Rome.

This was the perfect tour! There were only 6 of us in our tour group and we didn't have earpieces, which allowed for a very conversational, engaging tour. Our guide was wonderful! Of course skipping the long line, was certainly a plus too!!

When we arrived in St Peter's Square and saw the very long line we know we made the right decision to get a skip the line ticket. It is very much worth the extra price not to stand in that long line forever. Our guide was very knowledgeable and gave its a pleasant tour. We had adequate time to see things except in the Sistine Chapel where the guards were very rude and rushed us through. The tour ends in the Basilica and you can spend as much time there as you want. You will not regret taking the "skip the line".

So, we booked a small group tour of the Vatican City and met Luca at the meeting point. We had such a great day even though it was a little hectic, it didnt feel like it was quite as bad as that with the crowds.
Its pretty vast to see to whole site and you need someone with loads of passion and very knowledgeable to make you feel like a Roman which Luca certainly did this and he he was brilliant! It was a breath of fresh air to listen and learn from someone like this and make the whole experience very enjoyable.
Book this - you wont be disappointed and especially its only a max of 6 people so you get a much better service.

This was much more than a tour it was a master class of the museum, Sistine chapel and St Peter's. Our guide Luca was informed, charming and very well educated. My husband and I would definitely recommend this tour to all. It was particularly good because we were a small party of six. This way we were able to ask questions and dive deeper into the subject matter. The whole experience was fantastic. Thank you

With 9hrs of jet lag, 4 hours of sleep and 2 kids (9 & 11), I was skeptical that an early morning 4hr tour of the Vatican would be enjoyed. But our guide (Jade) was fantastic. Definitely recommend LivItaly Tours!

Our tour guide, Nadia, was absolutely fantastic. She is extremely knowledgeable and had a great program for us, tying together different parts of the museums through stories of Rome, Italy, and the Catholic Church. The small-group (my wife and I were the only ones to show up), skip-the-line premise allowed us to see more and spend 0 time waiting. We strongly recommend this tour to anyone looking to visit Vatican City. The museums are extensive and we wouldn't have gotten nearly as much out of our visit without an amazing guide like Nadia.
We thoroughly enjoyed out Vatican tour with Luca Romano! He was passionate about everything he showed us and his personality was fabulous! We had a great time! Thank you Luca!

We are a family of 6 who took this tour with Francesca. She was fabulous and very knowledgeable - and shared info with great excitement. Meeting place and time was easy and she supplemented the tour with close up views on her iPad so we could understand what to look for and what we were about to see before walking in. Francesca maximized the time and we really enjoyed the tour. Skipping the line is a GREAT VALUE and the best way to go for Sistine
Luca Romano - Great experience and wonderful tour guide .Highly recommended to travelers in Italy. We thoroughly enjoyed this tour.

This Tour was worth every penny, my wife and I learned so much from our guide Davide Falasca, he not only was quite scholarly and knowledgible regarding Roman History but World History as well, we learned so very much from Davide, more than we thought we would on a tour like this. We could of talked with Davide for hours longer and wish our tour never ended. We walked away with such an appreciation of the Vatican, the great works of Michelangelo and all the historical content that is housed in this magnificent work of art! Davide, Thank You so very much, we wish you and your wife well on your new blessing and hope we see you again on our next visit. Michael & Stacie from Texas

Well worth the extra money for being led around but given lots of insights into the detail behind some spectacular art and architecture. Our host was excellend and would definitely recommend LivItaly to anyone.

Deborah gave us a fantastic tour around the Vatican museum, Sistine Chapel and church. She was very knowledgeable and explained the history of the Vatican , the symbolism and the messages within the paintings. Would thouroghly recommend her guided tour and her personally. She really made the tour exceedingly interesting and informative.

Today we met with Deborah our guide for the tour of Vatican City. It was supposed to be a tour for a group of 6 but Michael & I were the only ones there so we had Deborah all to ourselves which was brilliant! We skipped the 2 hour long queue and spent 4 hours in the Vatican museums, Sistine Chapel, St Peters Basilica and main square with our extremely knowledgeable guide who made us feel very comfortable & welcome. Thanks for a great day Deborah, we'll certainly recommend you to family & friends who visit Rome in the future.
Allison & Michael

My wife and I went on a small group (6 person) skip the lines tour of the Vatican, Sistine Chapel, St. Peter's Basilica. It was a small intimate group. It truly was early access. Valerie is incredibly witty, intelligent and an outstanding tour guide. We spent 4 hours without being compressed. Other than LIVITALY, we saw no one have as good access or privacy. Every tour we take will be with LIVITALY!

We had the best time imaginable. The guides were extremely knowledgeable and friendly. There is so much history behind everything you see and they do a great job communicating that.

We liked the Vatican tour so much we used them for the coliseum tour as well.

What an amazing experience in a place so rich with History. We booked this tour simply to skip the line, however, we were shocked to discover we had actually booked one of the most culturally and historically rich experiences of our lives.
My partner and I joined the tour and we were completely shocked when our guide Giulia informed us we were the only ones on the tour. We quickly skipped the line and went into the museum. We were a little apprehensive with the private tour, hoping we would like the guide.
Well we were in for a surprise Giulia was incredible, she was informed, intelligent and loaded full of interesting information. It was a magical experience and anyway lucky enough to have Giulia take them through the Vatican and show them the secrets hidden in the halls should jump at the opportunity.

We had a late tour starting at 2:30. I do not think we would have survived if it were not for Giulia, our tour guide. She expertly wove us through the crowd and showed us all the splendor the museum and Sistine Chapel. (If we go back or if people i know go there in summer, I would suggest getting the early entrance private or small group tour at any cost! ) Of course Giulia stayed with us through St. Peter's and was a blessing to have as a guide!

Our guide, the effervescent, Eva Polino brought history to life for us. It was as if Michelangelo and Raphael were walking by our sides explaining and sometimes arguing about the origins of their magnificent art and the stories behind their commissions. Whether you have come to St. Peter's for the art, the history or the spiritual, this is the tour you want to take. It will give you a deeper understanding and appreciation for the achievements of the past and the hope for the future.

Francesca P was wonderful guide. We were the first ones into the Vatican and almost had the place to ourselves. Lots of history and facts. She definitely has a passion for the arts. So glad we did this tour and well worth it!!!! Picked a great day as there were only a couple of hundred people in the Sistine Chapel when we got there.

Of all the tours we’ve taken, this tour has to rank among the very best. Daniela made the history of the Vatican and the Popes and Artists who created it come alive. She is very knowledgable about the different time periods and all the intrigue which occurred between the players. She made it very enjoyable with her wit, humor and knowledge.
The small group tour is the best way to see this type of attraction, as Daniela had the time to answer our numerous questions without rushing us through the tour. We highly recommend Livitaly Tours and suggest you ask for Daniela S.

Everything about this company is first-class. I spoke with Angelo on the phone several times to determine which tour was best for our group of 12. Angelo even assisted me with making the online reservation. His English is perfect and he is hospitable, informative and friendly. A great start. We met our tour guide, Francesca, at the designated location across the street from the Vatican Museum. She gave us a short introduction after greeting everyone individually. Over the next 3 hours she took us through the tour while providing knowledgeable commentary on major works of art as well as the historical characters and the political and religious setting of the times. We visited the Vatican Museum, Raphael Rooms, Museum of Contemporary Art, the Sistine Chapel and St. Peter's Basilica. Francesca did a great job and everyone in our group enjoyed the experience. Bravo to livitaly.com, Angelo and Francesca!!!!

David was a great tour guide in enlightening us to all the wonders of the vatican museums and st peters. it was a great experience and a wonderful start to our 6 days in rome. he shared his passion for the museums and made sure we didn't feel rushed even with all the bustle around us. 5 stars!!! 6 if we could.

Our tour of the Vatican was outstanding. Our guide, Davide, was knowledgeable and engaging. Being in a small group made all the difference. Think about it. Why would anyone choose being in a large group of 25 wearing an audio headset instead of LivItaly's maximum group of 6? Everyone knows that the Vatican art collection is immense. I am convinced that taking a guided tour in a small-group setting makes the visit much more meaningful and enjoyable. My young adult daughter and I loved every minute of this tour. Davide was so much fun!

Our guide, Luca Pietro Santi was one of the best guides we have ever had. His knowledge of Rome, all things Vatican, etc were terrific. Luca moved us through the crowd (ours was a small group) and knew when to move away from sites to keep us together. He gave enough information about everything but didn't dominate the conversation. Luca had wonderful tidbits of trivia that made the sites real and fun. We loved his sense of humor! We really enjoyed our time at the Vatican and thank you to Luca.
